summary: Award recognition and many offices are strengths, but a footer phone link with a missing digit and stale details appear to cost you calls.

findings.problem: The footer shows 1-866-308-7722 but the link appears to dial tel:1866308772, a digit short.
findings.cost: An injured client who taps the number may not reach you.

findings.problem: Toronto appears as 416-408-4252, most offices as 1-866-308-7722, and Scarborough, Barrie and Sudbury as 705-722-6393, with the same fax number under several cities.
findings.cost: Mixed numbers confuse clients about who to call.
findings.fix: One main number and correct office details.

findings.problem: The firm appears under four names (Gluckstein And Associates, Jellinek Ellis Gluckstein Lawyers, Gluckstein Personal Injury Lawyers and Gluckstein LLP), 'Law Awwards' appears, and a headline appears cut off after 'Named 2027 National'.
findings.cost: Mixed names and typos weaken a premium firm.
findings.fix: One brand name and proofread news.

findings.problem: The footer appears to read 2022 while news is dated 2026, the 'See What Sets Gluckstein Apart' heading appears to have no content, and Seven versus 14 recognized lawyers appears in different sections.
findings.cost: Stale footer, empty sections and conflicting figures weaken proof.
findings.fix: Current footer, filled sections and one verified figure.

redesign: Tested phone links and one main number.
One brand name and proofread news.
